phases.name: Global financial crisis
phases.description: A worldwide banking scare led to a deep, long fall in share prices.

phases.name: Rupee and rate stress
phases.description: The rupee weakened sharply and interest rates were pushed up to calm things.

phases.name: Steady bull run
phases.description: Share prices rose slowly and steadily with few big shocks.

phases.name: COVID crash
phases.description: Lockdowns caused a very fast, very deep fall in a few weeks.

phases.name: Post-COVID rally
phases.description: Share prices bounced back quickly as economies reopened and rates stayed low.

phases.name: Rate-hike volatility
phases.description: Rising interest rates around the world made prices swing up and down.

Liquid / short-term debt.why: Short loans kept paying interest while rates were cut.

Hybrid.behaviour: fell, then recovered over about 1 year
Hybrid.why: The share part fell hard but the loan part cushioned it.

Index fund.behaviour: fell sharply, then recovered over about 2 years
Index fund.why: It follows the market, which fell deeply.

Flexi-cap equity.behaviour: fell sharply, then recovered over about 2 years
Flexi-cap equity.why: Company shares of all sizes fell as fear spread.

ELSS.behaviour: fell sharply, then recovered over about 2 years
ELSS.why: It holds company shares, which fell deeply.

Gold fund.why: People moved to gold when they were afraid.

Direct stocks (broad market).behaviour: fell sharply, some took many years to recover
Direct stocks (broad market).why: Share prices fell across the market.

Fixed deposit.why: The bank pays the agreed interest regardless of markets.

Liquid / short-term debt.behaviour: dipped briefly, then steadied within months
Liquid / short-term debt.why: A sudden jump in rates lowered the value of existing loans for a while.

Hybrid.behaviour: dipped, then recovered within about a year
Hybrid.why: Both shares and loans were hit by higher rates.

Index fund.behaviour: fell, then recovered within about a year
Index fund.why: Shares fell as money left the country.

Flexi-cap equity.behaviour: fell, then recovered within about a year
Flexi-cap equity.why: Smaller companies fell more as fear rose.

ELSS.behaviour: fell, then recovered within about a year
ELSS.why: It holds company shares hit by the stress.

Gold fund.why: A weaker rupee made gold costlier in India.

Direct stocks (broad market).behaviour: fell, then recovered within about a year
Direct stocks (broad market).why: Share prices dropped across the market.

Fixed deposit.why: Interest is fixed at the start, and new deposits paid more.

Hybrid.why: Shares rose while loans stayed calm.

Index fund.why: It followed a market that was rising calmly.

Flexi-cap equity.why: Many companies grew in a calm market.

ELSS.why: It holds company shares in a rising market.

Gold fund.why: With little fear, fewer people bought gold.

Direct stocks (broad market).behaviour: rose, though single shares varied a lot
Direct stocks (broad market).why: A calm, growing market lifted many shares.

Fixed deposit.why: Fixed interest, no link to markets.

Liquid / short-term debt.behaviour: dipped very slightly, then steadied in weeks
Liquid / short-term debt.why: A short scramble for cash, then rate cuts helped.

Hybrid.behaviour: fell, then recovered within about 6 months
Hybrid.why: The share part fell fast, the loan part softened it.

Index fund.behaviour: fell sharply, then recovered within about 8 months
Index fund.why: The whole market fell very fast.

Flexi-cap equity.behaviour: fell sharply, then recovered within about 8 months
Flexi-cap equity.why: Companies of all sizes fell together.

ELSS.behaviour: fell sharply, then recovered within about 8 months
ELSS.why: It holds company shares, which fell fast.

Gold fund.why: People turned to gold in a time of fear.

Direct stocks (broad market).behaviour: fell sharply; recovery varied widely by company
Direct stocks (broad market).why: Lockdowns hit many businesses at once.

Fixed deposit.why: The bank pays the agreed interest.

Liquid / short-term debt.why: Very low rates meant small interest.

Flexi-cap equity.why: Companies of many sizes recovered quickly.

ELSS.why: It holds company shares that bounced back.

Gold fund.why: As fear faded, less money went into gold.

Fixed deposit.why: Fixed interest, now at lower rates.

Liquid / short-term debt.why: New short loans paid more as rates rose.

Hybrid.behaviour: swung up and down, ended roughly flat
Hybrid.why: Shares wobbled and loan values dipped as rates rose.

Index fund.behaviour: swung up and down, ended roughly flat
Index fund.why: Rising rates made share prices jumpy.

Flexi-cap equity.behaviour: swung up and down, ended slightly lower
Flexi-cap equity.why: Higher rates weighed on company values.

ELSS.behaviour: swung up and down, ended slightly lower
ELSS.why: It holds company shares that wobbled.

Gold fund.why: Worry and a weaker rupee supported gold.

Direct stocks (broad market).behaviour: swung a lot, ended roughly flat
Direct stocks (broad market).why: Uncertainty about rates moved prices both ways.

Fixed deposit.why: Fixed interest, and new deposits paid more.
